_readme: IradOne programme data. schedule.js builds each day from this file, the same for every visitor. Times are Irad Time (UTC+6), 24-hour; times before 05:00 belong to the previous broadcast day. See newsroom/README.md (TV schedule) for how slots, rotations, episodes and specials work.

signon.title: Sign On
signon.desc: The broadcast day opens with the national anthem, The Spirit of Irad.

signoff.title: Sign Off
signoff.desc: The channel closes for the night with The Spirit of Irad.

morning_news.title: OneNews Morning
morning_news.desc: Daily news updates covering local and international events, with weather for the valleys and the passes.

midday_news.title: OneNews Midday
midday_news.desc: Comprehensive news update covering politics, economy and culture.

afternoon_news.title: OneNews Afternoon
afternoon_news.desc: A brief news update with a focus on stories and community events that matter to you.

news_at_eight.title: OneNews at Eight
news_at_eight.desc: The main English-language evening bulletin, live from the Alikhan Media Center in Talas.

kechki.title: Kechki Jañylyktar
kechki.subtitle: Evening News in Iradi

late_news.title: OneNews Late
late_news.desc: Summary of the day's top stories and events.

week_in_irad.title: OneWeek

voices_of_janyl.title: Voices of Janyl
